The '''Narkis Highlands''' were an area of the [[Narkis Desert]] on the Pilgrim Moon [[Jedha]], orbiting the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[NaJedha]]. The highlands were the namesake of the [[Narkis Anchorite]] group, since members of the monastic cult frequently visited the area. The Narkis Highlands were home to [[the Archive]], which served as a hidden base for [[Jedi Master]]s [[Cere Junda]] and [[Eno Cordova]], and [[Pilgrim's Sanctuary]], a safe house for the [[Hidden Path]].<ref name="Survivor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Narkis Highlands first appeared in the [[2023]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]],'' and the area served as a playable location.<ref name="Survivor" />
